name: Per-Pixel Sorting (General Variant)
definition: Variants that sort all faces projecting onto a pixel (not just exterior faces) at render time, just prior to compositing. They handle visibility cycles gracefully since a visibility sort always exists for each pixel center even if no global sort exists.
summary: Per-Pixel Sorting (General Variant) is an image-space method that sorts all projected cell faces per pixel using buckets and lists, differing from others by handling cycles and avoiding distance metrics.
